learning_outcomes.text: The student can describe the major principles of Android
The student can apply the different principles in an assignment
The student analyzes the problem and translates this into a program structure and associated algorithms
The student converts the structure into a program using Java/Kotlin code specific to Android
The student converts the algorithms into the program using Java/Kotlin code
The student verifies the operation of the program against the requirements of the assignment

assessment_rules: The course is evaluated using two activities: a theory exam and a lab exam. The theory exam evaluates learning outcome (1), while the lab exam evaluates learning outcomes (2) - (6). If the student achieves a score of <7 on one of the evaluation activities, the student can achieve a maximum of 9/20 for the entire course unit. Partial transfers for successful results (YT6060 - App Development: Theory and YT6091 - App Development: Lab) are available within and across academic years.
